study type: secondary analysis of a cesarean registry
outcome: Postpartum infectious morbidity (endometritis, wound infection, inpatient wound complication, readmission due to wound complications)
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery and had BMI >= 40 kg/m2 in the Maternal-Fetal Medicine Units Cesarean Registry.
finding: Women with BMI 50 to 70+ kg/m2 are at an increased risk of postpartum wound infections and complications compared with women with BMI 40 to 49.9 kg/m2.
